def ov(M,L,h):
    p='%s.layers.%d.'%(M,L)
    win=1+weights[p+'input_layernorm.weight']; wpost=1+weights[p+'post_attention_layernorm.weight']
    Wv=weights[p+'self_attn.v_proj.weight']; Wo=weights[p+'self_attn.o_proj.weight'][:,256*h:256*h+256]
    A=(ET*win)@Wv.T@Wo.T*wpost*wf   # [n,640]
    return A
def copyscore(A):
    M=A@ET.T
    d=np.diag(M); 
    # rank of diag in each row
    ranks=(M>d[:,None]).sum(1)
    return d.mean()-M.mean(), np.mean(ranks==0), np.median(ranks)

def ovfull(M,L,h,src,dst):
    p='%s.layers.%d.'%(M,L)
    win=1+weights[p+'input_layernorm.weight']; wpost=1+weights[p+'post_attention_layernorm.weight']
    Wv=weights[p+'self_attn.v_proj.weight']; Wo=weights[p+'self_attn.o_proj.weight'][:,256*h:256*h+256]
    x=E[src]*win; x=x/np.sqrt((x**2).mean(1,keepdims=True))  # normalize rows (rmsnorm of weight-embed product)
    A=x@Wv.T@Wo.T*wpost*wf
    return A@E[dst].T

def gencopy(M,L,h,S):

    win=1+weights[p+'input_layernorm.weight']; wpost=1+weights[p+'post_attention_layernorm.weight']
    Wv=weights[p+'self_attn.v_proj.weight']; Wo=weights[p+'self_attn.o_proj.weight'][:,256*h:256*h+256]
    x=E[S]*win; x=x/np.sqrt((x**2).mean(1,keepdims=True))
    A=(x@Wv.T@Wo.T)*wpost*wf
    m=A@E[S].T
    return (np.diag(m)-m.mean(1)).mean()

    p='layers.%d.'%L

    Wv=weights[Mv+'.'+p+'self_attn.v_proj.weight']; Wo=weights[Mo+'.'+p+'self_attn.o_proj.weight'][:,256*h:256*h+256]

    m=(x@Wv.T@Wo.T)*wpost*wf@E[S].T
    s=0
    for i in range(8):
        same=[i%4,i%4+4]; s+=m[i][same].mean()-np.delete(m[i],same).mean()
    return s/8

def lscoreS(L,h,M,S1,S2):
    p='%s.layers.%d.'%(M,L)
    win=1+weights[p+'input_layernorm.weight']; wpost=1+weights[p+'post_attention_layernorm.weight']
    Wv=weights[p+'self_attn.v_proj.weight']; Wo=weights[p+'self_attn.o_proj.weight'][:,256*h:256*h+256]
    S=S1+S2; k=len(S1)
    x=E[S]*win; x=x/np.sqrt((x**2).mean(1,keepdims=True))
    m=(x@Wv.T@Wo.T)*wpost*wf@E[S].T
    s=0
    for i in range(len(S)):
        same=[j for j in range(len(S)) if j%k==i%k]; s+=m[i][same].mean()-np.delete(m[i],same).mean()
    return s/len(S)
